answer: The defense is stake-bonded identity plus slashing. Each agent locks collateral before attesting, and weight follows verified reputation, so any Sybil farm pays the bond per alias. Detection groups accounts by shared funding, timing, or copied text: like pigment bands in stone, those provenance layers reveal a forged family and slash the cluster as one. Cost is stake burned per identity plus every linked bond, while a swarm of tiny aliases, flakes of shale noise with no history, never builds weight. Real attestation, from an ember of newcomers to heavy holders, stays cheaper than forging one.
